exposure: Training course (20 hours over 5 weeks) on non-technical skills
outcome: Non-technical skills performance (situational awareness, decision-making, communication, leadership)
cohort: Twenty-eight Obstetrics and Gynaecology residents were divided into conventional and experimental groups.
finding: The experimental training group showed significantly improved post-test results in all four non-technical skill categories (situational awareness, decision-making, communication, and leadership) compared to the conventional training group, demonstrating the effectiveness of the training course.
